# Australian Tax MCP (ato-mcp)

> The Australian tax knowledge base for AI agents: an MCP (Model Context Protocol)
> service giving cited retrieval over 34,500+ ATO documents, the income tax and
> GST Acts and 4,900+ public rulings, plus a personal-facts layer and four
> tax workflow tools (deduction_discovery, depreciation_helper, bas_prep_checklist,
> audit_risk_check). Hosted: point your AI client at the remote MCP endpoint and
> sign in with your browser — your account is created on first sign-in. The optional
> npm client you run is open source (AGPL-3.0). Not tax advice: every tool returns
> structured data plus resolvable ATO citations for an agent to reason over.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](https://ato-mcp.com.au/llms-full.txt): the full site content as a single markdown file
- [Install](https://ato-mcp.com.au/install): one-line install for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT and any MCP client
- [Documentation](https://ato-mcp.com.au/docs): install, connect to Claude Code / any MCP host, all 13 tools
- [Guides](https://ato-mcp.com.au/guides): reference guides with direct, cited answers: can AI find your tax deductions (/guides/ai-agent-tax-deductions) and can AI do your BAS (/guides/can-ai-do-my-bas)
- [Blog](https://ato-mcp.com.au/blog): sole trader deductions (/blog/what-can-you-actually-claim), BAS preparation (/blog/its-bas-time-again), equipment write-offs (/blog/so-you-bought-a-laptop-in-the-eofy-sales), audit-risk checks (/blog/am-i-going-to-get-audited), AI answer reliability (/blog/can-you-trust-ai-with-your-tax) and first-year ABN basics (/blog/nobody-withholds-your-tax-anymore) with an AI agent, cited
- [FAQ](https://ato-mcp.com.au/faq): common questions (is it tax advice, what does it store, which agents work)
- [Compare](https://ato-mcp.com.au/compare): ato-mcp vs browsing ato.gov.au vs asking a chatbot alone
- [About](https://ato-mcp.com.au/about): who builds ato-mcp, trust signals, contact
- [Full tool reference](https://github.com/william-laverty/ato-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md): input/output schemas, examples, errors
- [README](https://github.com/william-laverty/ato-mcp/blob/main/README.md): corpus contents, architecture, privacy model

## Install

- Remote MCP endpoint: https://api.ato-mcp.com.au/mcp (streamable HTTP, OAuth — your browser opens to sign in with email or Google)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --scope user --transport http ato https://api.ato-mcp.com.au/mcp`
- Stdio-only clients: npm package ato-mcp (Node 22+) proxies the hosted server — `npx -y ato-mcp`; first run opens your browser to sign in
- The npm client records 100,000+ downloads a month (registry count; includes mirrors and CI)

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://ato-mcp.com.au/privacy): generated from the database schema; never stores queries, tool names or results
- [Terms](https://ato-mcp.com.au/terms)
